description: Workjournal is a structured work journal built for multi-agent and multi-teammate collaboration. Log decisions, session rationale, and project notes directly from ChatGPT or any AI agent. Every entry is instantly searchable and shareable across your team. Use Workjournal to surface the context behind past decisions, hand off work between agents, and keep a living record of why your project evolved the way it did.
